description: Cases for the team rules engine. Each case: a rule set (an example team file of design/examples, an inline team file, or none for coded CLI behaviour), the items before, one command, and the expected result. The evaluator spike runs every case (design/evaluator-spike/evaluator.test.mjs); the BDD plan turns each into a scenario.
